title: Anthony D. Perkins
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Married Christine D. Abbott, Nov. 21, 1981, Salt Lake Temple; six children

Bachelor's in finance, BYU, 1984; MBA from University of Pennsylvania's Wharton School, concurrent Master's degree from University of Pennsylvania in international studies with concentration on East Asia, 1988.
Employment: McKinsey & Company, a management consulting firm; most recently, a senior partner.
Elders Quorum President; Branch President; District President
